column3: Kuroneko Route · A Midsummer Day's Dream
Well now... What should I do?
I'm not obliged to listen to anything you say.
From the looks of things, should I give it another try?
What should I say anyway...? Or should I just monitor the situation quietly...
...At a loss for words?
After coming all this way, you've run out of words to say? You're so useless...
N-No, it's nothing like that....!
Damn... Staying quiet had the opposite effect...
I know I'm being long-winded, but please.
I'm hiding something is written all over your face. Doesn't it just feel weird when you don't want me to be concerned over this?
......Oh well, it could probably be because of me that you're doing so much.
So you want to hear it, no matter what?
No matter what.
...I see.
Yeah, that's right.
So... I am considered one of your 【important friends】?
Guh... So embarrassing to hear her repeat it like that...
Well, now that I came so far, it'd be wrong to try and dodge the subject...
Y-Yeah... You might say that.
Heh, is that so...
That's fine then, I'll give you a reward. Since you answered so honestly.
Why are you looking down on me? Wait, a reward...?
Yes...
I shall answer you.
You're such a hopeless person, aren't you...
*sigh* How pathetic... Fine then...
There's no way around it, so listen well.
R-Really...
Thanks.
...I guess you have heard from Saori? About my circle taking part in the upcoming Summer Comiket.
Yeah, I've heard about it.
That piece of manuscript hasn't been proceeding as smoothly as planned.
So now I'm falling behind and trying to turn it around... That's all.
...That's all?
Yes. That's all.
...Really?
...You sure are persistent.
Hmm... Then leave this to me! I will--
I don't need it.
I haven't even said anything yet!?
You would say "Allow me to help out!" anyway, right?
...Can you read my mind?
Do you know what an "unwelcome favor" means? That's what you are right now.
Can you please not misunderstand? I'm only telling you this because you're being persistent and I don't have the slightest intention of letting you take part.
...So please don't do any more unnecessary things.
Unnecessary things...? I just want to help you...
Haven't I said it before? It's better to keep away from hindrances. These are all obstacles when it comes to production of works.
Am I really being a hindrance?
That's right. It is troublesome if I were to allow an amateur to take part.
Do you understand now? Can you even draw manga?
...It's true that I can't, but I also know this.
Oh?
An "assistant" is required when it comes to manga, right?
Furthermore, there are many other things to do... That even an amateur could help out with.
Oh, this is a surprise... Senpai actually knows about these things.
Because I have known you long enough, that's why I know just this much.
...Hmph, all right.
This is all just a façade anyway.
A façade?
I shall inform you of the truth.
It will surely hurt you... But you would still want to hear it anyway, right? Therefore...
...Are you prepared?
Yeah, any time.
Hehe, you have some nerve... Well then, allow me to tell you.
To me, creating is the act of taking a fragment of my mind and recreate it, sublime it.
It is no exaggeration when I say that I created something new.
Which is why I shall not allow anyone to trespass on this domain.
Especially someone like you, who doesn't even know where he stands. Never.
Although her method of putting this across is unique, in short, isn't it still about that?
Don't come close to me. Isn't that what you're trying to say, Kuroneko?
I should have said it before, if one were to step into the domain, punishment will be met.
Your punishment is my rejection. Are you able to withstand this punishment?
...Ah, I can't stand it... I can't bear it at all.
...I'm sorry.
Hmph... I'm glad that you understand.
Damn it... I sure am useless.
...I didn't expect to be rejected so straightforwardly.
Just when I thought Kuroneko would listen to me if I pushed on strongly...
And I thought our relationship would be fixed...
